'''Ramiz Aliguliyev''' ({{langx|az|Ramiz Məhəmməd oğlu Alıquliyev}}; March 20, 1961) is an [[Azerbaijan]]i computer scientist, director of the Institute of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at [[Azerbaijan Technical University]]<ref>[https://www.aztu.edu.az/sub_site/en/kibertehlukesizlik-ve-suni-intellekt-institutu-77/page/direktor-714 Institute of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence]</ref>, head of department at the Institute of Information Technology of [[Ministry of Science and Education (Azerbaijan)|Ministry of Science and Education]], doctor of technical sciences, professor, corresponding member of [[Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences]] (ANAS).<ref name="ict">[https://ict.az/en/content/39 Ramiz Aliguliyev (ict.az)]</ref>

== Biography ==
Ramiz Aliguliyev was born on March 20, 1961, in [[Barda District|Barda district]], Azerbaijan SSR.<ref name="təqvim">{{cite book |last= |first= |date=2020 |title=Əlamətdar və tarixi günlər təqvimi - 2021 |url=https://anl.az/down/teqvim_2021.pdf |location=Baku |publisher=[[Azerbaijan National Library]] |page=118 |isbn= 9789952542042|access-date=}}</ref><ref name="science">{{Cite web |title=Aliguliyev Ramiz Mahammad oglu |url=https://science.gov.az/en/forms/chlenyikorrespondentyi/3045 |access-date=2026-02-20 |website=science.gov.az}}</ref>

In 1983, he graduated from the Faculty of Applied Mathematics of the Azerbaijan State University named after S. M. Kirov (currently [[Baku State University]]).<ref name="science"/><ref name="təqvim"/>

In 1983-1988, he worked at the Institute of Cybernetics of the Azerbaijan SSR Academy of Sciences, and in 1988-2002, at the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics.<ref name="təqvim"/>

In 2003, he worked as the head of the sector at the Institute of Information Technology,<ref name="təqvim"/><ref name="ict"/> and since 2004, he has been working as the head of the department.

In 2017, he was elected a corresponding member of ANAS.<ref name="təqvim"/>

==Research areas==
Artificial Intelligence; Data Mining; Big Data Analytics; Natural Language Processing (NLP); Text Mining; E-government Analysis; Scientometrics; Evolutionary and Swarm Intelligence Algorithms.<ref name="ict"/>

==Scientific activity==
In 2000-2002, he completed his doctoral studies at the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics (now the Institute of Mathematics).<ref name="ict"/>

In 2002, he defended his PhD dissertation entitled “''Investigation of the Qualitative Properties of Solutions to Second-Order Degenerate Elliptic Equations''” for the degree of Candidate of Physical and Mathematical Sciences (Doctor of Philosophy) in the specialty 01.01.02 (1211.01) – Differential Equations at the Dissertation Council of the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics (now the Institute of Mathematics).<ref name="science"/><ref name="təqvim"/>

In 2004–2009, he completed the Doctor of Sciences program at the Institute of Information Technology. In 2010, he defended his doctoral dissertation entitled “''Methods and Algorithms for Intelligent Analysis of Textual Information''” at the Dissertation Council of the Institute of Cybernetics (now the Institute of Mathematics) for the degree of Doctor of Technical Sciences.<ref name="science"/><ref name="təqvim"/>

In 2019, he was invited to Federation University Australia to conduct joint research.<ref>{{Cite web |title=AMEA-nın müxbir üzvü Ramiz Alıquliyev Avstraliya Federasiya Universitetində elmi ezamiyyətdə olub |url=https://science.gov.az/az/news/open/9759 |publisher=science.gov.az |language=az |date=2019-02-13}}</ref>

Aliguliyev has supervised 4 PhDs. He currently supervising 12 PhD students.<ref name="ict"/>

== Awards ==
In 2005, he received Diploma of Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences.<ref name="science"/>

In 2013, his article was awarded 1st place for the best scientific work in the "3rd Joint ICT Award Competition" held by the Science Development Foundation under the president of the Republic of Azerbaijan, together with the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology.<ref name="ict"/>

In 2014, he was awarded the [[Tereggi Medal|"Taraggi" medal]] by the order of the president of the Republic of Azerbaijan.<ref name="e-qanun"/>

In 2020–2025 Ramiz Aliguliyev has been recognized among the world's top 2% of scientists in the field of artificial intelligence identified by Stanford University.<ref>{{Cite web |title=World's Top 2% Scientists by Stanford University in 2020 |url=https://elsevier.digitalcommonsdata.com/datasets/btchxktzyw/2 |access-date=2022-03-31 |archive-date=2022-06-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220618111054/https://elsevier.digitalcommonsdata.com/datasets/btchxktzyw/2 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=World's Top 2% Scientists by Stanford University in 2021 |url=https://elsevier.digitalcommonsdata.com/datasets/btchxktzyw/3 |access-date=2022-03-31 |archive-date=2022-02-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220221130633/https://elsevier.digitalcommonsdata.com/datasets/btchxktzyw/3 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title="World's Top 2% Scientists by Stanford University in 2022" |url=https://elsevier.digitalcommonsdata.com/datasets/btchxktzyw/5 |access-date=2022-11-16 |archive-date=2022-11-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221118072830/https://elsevier.digitalcommonsdata.com/datasets/btchxktzyw/5 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://elsevier.digitalcommonsdata.com/datasets/btchxktzyw/6 |title="World's Top 2% Scientists by Stanford University in 2023". |access-date=2023-10-19 |archive-date=2023-10-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231019153920/https://elsevier.digitalcommonsdata.com/datasets/btchxktzyw/6 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title="World's Top 2% Scientists by Stanford University in 2024" |url=https://elsevier.digitalcommonsdata.com/datasets/btchxktzyw/7 |access-date=2024-09-16 |archive-date=2024-09-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917120000/https://elsevier.digitalcommonsdata.com/datasets/btchxktzyw/7 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=World's Top 2% Scientists by Stanford University in 2025
